title: fix: stop logging successful update progress as errors
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes successful update and repair phases appearing as errors in OpenClaw logs without moving the documented progress stream away from stderr.

## User Impact

Successful progress remains immediately visible on stderr while file logs use info severity. Advisory records use warning severity, failed phases remain errors, and JSON stdout stays parseable.

## Why This Change Was Made

Finalization sent every phase record through the error console method. Route each record by its existing outcome, write healthy phase diagnostics directly to stderr, and preserve the same ledger records. This candidate-side change also applies when an installed updater invokes finalization; no state or schema migration is introduced.

## Evidence

- The stderr regression fails on the reviewed pre-fix implementation with zero stderr calls, then passes after the repair.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/update-cli/update-finalization-lifecycle.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 22 tests pass, 38.70 s wall.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/update-finalization-output.process.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 18 real subprocess cases pass, 233.88 s wall, including human and JSON stream placement. This file exceeds 30 seconds because it proves child-process exit, timeout, inherited-run, and stdout/stderr contracts that a unit fixture cannot cover.
- Changed-file ratchets, formatting, boundaries, core types, and six selected core-test type graphs pass. The full-tree Knip preflight cannot resolve `@openclaw/libterminal` in this linked worktree even after `pnpm install`; its independent script and production scans both report zero findings.
- Fresh staged P1 autoreview is scoped-clean.
- Exact CI follow-up identified test-only `no-useless-escape`, `unbound-method`, and stderr-spy typing defects; core lint stripe 1/5 and the `core-test-cli-update` type graph pass after repair, and the affected lifecycle suite remains 22/22 green.
- The previous current-head CI type failure was unrelated (`postMigrationGenerations` in `doctor-maintenance.database-writes.test.ts`) and is fixed in the retained base by `5a7f24abb78`.

- `CI=1 pnpm test:docker:published-upgrade-survivor`: passes on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m3tsdbgrwkt5ep05zpxa9ywj` at production head `c6adc581e57` (the later head changes only test lint), including candidate packaging and the published-release-to-candidate update lane; 14m37s command wall, 327s real Docker lane.
